```{r global, include=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse) 
library(knitr)
library(DT)
BLM <- read_csv("blm_colorado_3.csv")

BLM <- BLM %>%
  rename(Address1 = `Address_1`,
         Address2 = `Address_2`,
         ZipCode = `Zip_Code`,
         PhoneNumber = `Phone_Number`,
         TotalActivities = total_activities,
         DescriptionCharacterLength = `Description_Length`,
         DescriptionLengthWords = `Description_Length_Words`,
         DirectionCharacterLength = `Direction_Length`,
         DirectionLengthWords = `Direction_Length_Words`)

print(BLM)
BLM
```

About
==========================

Column {data-width = 400}
-------------------------

#### Authors

Max Hickman and Logan Samuelson

#### Background Information

The Bureau of Land Management manages 245 million acres of land across the US, measuring a tenth of America's land. While BLM public lands are less visited than national parks, they are known for offering more activities with less restrictions than national parks. In 2024, BLM public lands hosted 80 million visitors. Colorado is a state with over 150 BLM public lands sites varying from museums to open wilderness, to trail systems and boat access points. Some dashboards exist for finding public lands based on activities, but they have limited info on filtering sites and measuring characteristics such as number of activities and description length. A better dashboard would allow potential visitors to plan trips better-- understanding what different sites have to offer and the most interesting sites based off of description length-- among other benefits. We wish to contribute this dashboard

+ [BLM Visitor Info](https://www.blm.gov/blog/2025-06-26/blm-public-lands-know-you-go)
+ [BLM Overview](https://www.blm.gov/about/what-we-manage/national)

#### Our Key Questions

What is the primary attraction type of each site and what is the distribution

What sites have the longest descriptions? Does this correlate to activities offered?

What sites have certain activities?

#### Data Sources

+ Data from scraped from [BLM Programs](https://www.blm.gov/visit/search?field_location=100035&field_activities=All&search_api_fulltext=&page=) 
+ **2 sites do not have information in our dataset

BLM Site Descriptions/Direction Length and Activity Count
==========================

Inputs {.sidebar}
-------------------------
```{r, echo=FALSE}

typeories <- c(
  "Backcountry|Wilderness"          = "Wilderness",
  "Recreation Site|Rec Site"        = "Recreation Site",
  "Historic District|Museum"        = "Historic Site",
  "Boat Launch|Boat Ramp"           = "Boat Launch",
  "Trailhead|Trail System|Trail"    = "Trail"
)

labels <- c(
  "Road", "RMZ", "WSA", "OHV", "Fishing Access",
  "National Monument", "community Site", "River Access",
  "Byway", "Day Use Area", "SRMA", "Management Area",
  "Campground", "conservation Area", "HMA"
)
label_set <- setNames(labels, labels)

attraction_type <- c(typeories, label_set)

inputPanel(
  checkboxGroupInput(
  inputID = "Activity",
  label = h3("Activity"),
  choices = c("CAMPING","WATER SPORTS","ENVIRONMENTAL EDUCATION","NON-MOTORIZED BOATING","DAY USE AREA", "PADDLE BOATING","WATER ACCESS","RAFTING","WHITEWATER RAFTING","BIRDING", "BACKPACKING","INTERPRETIVE PROGRAMS","WILDLIFE VIEWING","FISHING", "BOATING", "HORSEBACK RIDING","HIKING", "OFF HIGHWAY VEHICLE", "RECREATIONAL VEHICLES","SENIC DRIVE","PHOTOGRAPHY","CLIMBING", "HUNTING","WILDERNESS","INFORMATION SITE","PICNICKING"),
  selected = NULL
))
```


Column 
-------------------------

```{r}
filtered_activity <- reactive({
  BLM_df
  if (length(input$Activity) == 0) return(BLM_df)
  for (col in input$Activity) { 
    BLM_df <- BLM_df[BLM_df[[col]] == 1, ]
  }
    BLM_df
})

renderDT({
  datatable(filtered_activity(),
            options = list(pageLength = 5),
            rownames = FALSE)
})
```


```{r, echo = FALSE}
renderPlot({
    BLM %>%
      filter(HIKING == input$Activity) %>%
      filter(DescriptionLengthWords < input$cutoff) %>%
      select(input$type, "HIKING") %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = .data[[input$type]], y = HIKING)) +
      geom_bar() +
      coord_flip() 
})
```

Column 
-------------------------

```{r, echo = FALSE}
renderPlot({
    BLM %>% as_tibble() %>%
      mutate(x = BLM[[input$type]]) %>%
      group_by(x) %>%
      summarise(meanprice = mean(SalePrice, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
      mutate(x = fct_reorder(x, meanprice)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = x, y = meanprice)) +
      geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
      labs(x = input$type)
})
```

Numerical Predictors
==========================

<center>

```{r, echo=FALSE}
inputPanel(
      selectInput(inputId = "numer",
                  label = h3("Numeric predictors"),
                  choices = c("Description Word Count" = "Descrpt", 
                              "Overall Quality" = "OverallQual", 
                              "Year Built" = "YearBuilt", 
                              "Above Ground Sqft" = "SqFtAboveGrd", 
                              "Bedrooms" = "Bedrooms"),
                  selected = "Above Ground Sqft"),
      numericInput(inputId = "cutoff2", 
                   label = h3("Exclude prices above:"), 
                   value = 500000)
)

renderPlot({
    BLM %>%
      filter(SalePrice < input$cutoff2) %>%
      select(input$numer, "SalePrice") %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = .data[[input$numer]], y = SalePrice)) +
      geom_point() +
      geom_smooth() 
})
```
